test_kmeans_runs: test the KMeansCluster class to verify it runs without nan values across parameterized inputs
run_KMeansCluster_fit: run KMeansCluster fit method on random JAX arrays to compute centroids and counts
test_centroid_shapes: test that KMeansCluster output centroids match expected shape of num_centroids by dim_x
test_finite_outputs: test that KMeansCluster fit returns finite values for centroids, counts, and std_distance
run_parameterized_kmeans_test: run parameterized KMeans test with varying num_x, dim_x, and num_centroids combinations
